title: Health and the doctor
focus: 症状 · 过敏 · 发炎 · 恢复 · 体检 · 失眠 · 住院 · 手术
body:
# Health and the doctor

Words for the doctor's office and the hospital: symptoms, allergies, checkups and surgery. You need them for your own health and for looking after parents.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 症状 | zhèngzhuàng | symptom | the shape a disease takes |
| 过敏 | guòmǐn | to be allergic / allergy | overly sensitive → allergic |
| 发炎 | fāyán | to become inflamed (a wound, throat) | break out in flames → inflamed |
| 恢复 | huīfù | to recover / get back to normal (gradually) | get back to how it was |
| 体检 | tǐjiǎn | medical checkup / physical exam | body check → medical checkup |
| 失眠 | shīmián | insomnia / can't sleep | lose sleep → insomnia |
| 住院 | zhùyuàn | to be hospitalized / stay in hospital | stay in the institution → hospitalized |
| 手术 | shǒushù | surgery / operation | hand technique → surgery |

## Which word?

**体检 vs 检查 (L10)**: 体检 is the routine full-body checkup. 检查 is any check or test, including a specific one the doctor orders (去医院检查一下).

## Sentences

- 压力一大，我就失眠。 yālì yí dà, wǒ jiù shīmián: Whenever I'm under a lot of stress, I can't sleep.
- 嗓子发炎了，吃药也没什么作用。 sǎngzi fāyán le, chī yào yě méi shénme zuòyòng: My throat's inflamed, and the medicine isn't doing anything.
- 体检才发现我对猫过敏，可Ollie怎么办？ tǐjiǎn cái fāxiàn wǒ duì māo guòmǐn, kě Ollie zěnme bàn: I only found out at my checkup that I'm allergic to cats. What about Ollie?
- 住院之前，医生要再检查一次。 zhùyuàn zhīqián, yīshēng yào zài jiǎnchá yí cì: Before you're admitted, the doctor wants to run one more check.
- 失眠也是一种症状，别不当回事。 shīmián yě shì yì zhǒng zhèngzhuàng, bié bú dàng huí shì: Insomnia is a symptom too. Don't brush it off.
- 因为发炎，手术推迟到下周了。 yīnwèi fāyán, shǒushù tuīchí dào xià zhōu le: Because of the inflammation, the surgery has been pushed to next week.
- 我爸太固执，还没恢复就要出院。 wǒ bà tài gùzhí, hái méi huīfù jiù yào chūyuàn: My dad is so stubborn. He wants to leave hospital before he's even recovered.
- 手术以后恢复得慢也正常，要有耐心。 shǒushù yǐhòu huīfù de màn yě zhèngcháng, yào yǒu nàixīn: It's normal to recover slowly after surgery. Be patient.

cards.Example: 你还有别的症状吗? nǐ hái yǒu bié de zhèngzhuàng ma: Do you have any other symptoms?
cards.Notes: 症 zhèng disease, 疒 sickness radical (病, 疼, 痛 share it) + 状 zhuàng shape, condition (状态, 形状) = the shape a disease takes, so a symptom. 抑郁症 = depression (症 as illness name).

cards.Example: 我对青霉素过敏。 wǒ duì qīngméisù guòmǐn: I'm allergic to penicillin
cards.Notes: 过 guò too much, exceed (过分, 太过) + 敏 mǐn quick, sensitive (敏感) = overly sensitive, so allergic. Pattern: 对…过敏 = allergic to …

cards.Example: 伤口发炎了。 shāngkǒu fāyán le: The wound is inflamed
cards.Notes: 发 fā break out, give off (发烧, 发火) + 炎 yán blaze, 火 + 火 (炎热) = break out in flames, so become inflamed. 嗓子发炎 = sore, inflamed throat. 炎 ends many illnesses: 肺炎, 肠胃炎.

cards.English: to recover / get back to normal (gradually)
cards.Example: 他手术后恢复得很好。 tā shǒushù hòu huīfù de hěn hǎo: He's recovering well after the operation
cards.Notes: 恢 huī (opaque on its own; seen almost only in this word) + 复 fù return, back again (复习, 回复) = get back to how it was, so recover gradually. Also non-medical: 恢复正常 = back to normal. Shares 复 with 康复.

cards.Example: 公司每年安排一次体检。 gōngsī měi nián ānpái yí cì tǐjiǎn: The company arranges a checkup every year
cards.Notes: 体 tǐ body (身体, 体育) + 检 jiǎn check, inspect (检查) = body check, a medical checkup. Short for 身体检查. 年度体检 = annual physical.

cards.Example: 我最近老失眠。 wǒ zuìjìn lǎo shīmián: I keep having trouble sleeping lately
cards.Notes: 失 shī lose (失去, 丢失) + 眠 mián sleep, 目 eye (睡眠, 冬眠) = lose sleep, so insomnia / can't sleep.

cards.English: to be hospitalized / stay in hospital
cards.Example: 奶奶住院一个星期了。 nǎinai zhùyuàn yí ge xīngqī le: Grandma has been in hospital for a week
cards.Notes: 住 zhù live, stay (住在) + 院 yuàn courtyard, institution (医院, 院子, 电影院) = stay in the hospital. Mirror: 出院 = be discharged.

cards.Example: 我爸下周要做手术。 wǒ bà xià zhōu yào zuò shǒushù: My dad is having surgery next week
cards.Notes: 手 shǒu hand + 术 shù skill, technique (技术, 美术, 艺术) = hand technique, so surgery. 做手术 = have (or perform) surgery.

cards.English: Whenever I'm under a lot of stress, I can't sleep.
cards.Pinyin: yālì yí dà, wǒ jiù shīmián.
cards.Notes: 失眠 (L13) + 压力 (L4). 一……就…… = whenever ..., then ...

cards.English: My throat's inflamed, and the medicine isn't doing anything.
cards.Hanzi: 嗓子发炎了，吃药也没什么作用。
cards.Pinyin: sǎngzi fāyán le, chī yào yě méi shénme zuòyòng.
cards.Notes: 发炎 (L13) + 作用 (L11). 嗓子发炎 = sore, inflamed throat.

cards.English: I only found out at my checkup that I'm allergic to cats. What about Ollie?
cards.Hanzi: 体检才发现我对猫过敏，可Ollie怎么办？
cards.Pinyin: tǐjiǎn cái fāxiàn wǒ duì māo guòmǐn, kě Ollie zěnme bàn?
cards.Notes: 体检 (L13) + 过敏 (L13). 对……过敏 = allergic to ...

cards.English: Before you're admitted, the doctor wants to run one more check.
cards.Hanzi: 住院之前，医生要再检查一次。
cards.Pinyin: zhùyuàn zhīqián, yīshēng yào zài jiǎnchá yí cì.
cards.Notes: 住院 (L13) + 检查 (L10). Mirror: 出院 = be discharged.

cards.English: Insomnia is a symptom too. Don't brush it off.
cards.Hanzi: 失眠也是一种症状，别不当回事。
cards.Pinyin: shīmián yě shì yì zhǒng zhèngzhuàng, bié bú dàng huí shì.
cards.Notes: 失眠 (L13) + 症状 (L13). 不当回事 = not take seriously.

cards.English: Because of the inflammation, the surgery has been pushed to next week.
cards.Hanzi: 因为发炎，手术推迟到下周了。
cards.Pinyin: yīnwèi fāyán, shǒushù tuīchí dào xià zhōu le.
cards.Notes: 发炎 (L13) + 手术 (L13) + 推迟 (L5). 推迟到 + time = postpone until.

cards.English: My dad is so stubborn. He wants to leave hospital before he's even recovered.
cards.Hanzi: 我爸太固执，还没恢复就要出院。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ bà tài gùzhí, hái méi huīfù jiù yào chūyuàn.
cards.Notes: 恢复 (L13) + 固执 (L12). 还没……就…… = already ... before even ...

cards.English: It's normal to recover slowly after surgery. Be patient.
cards.Hanzi: 手术以后恢复得慢也正常，要有耐心。
cards.Pinyin: shǒushù yǐhòu huīfù de màn yě zhèngcháng, yào yǒu nàixīn.
cards.Notes: 手术 (L13) + 恢复 (L13) + 耐心 (L12). 恢复 is gradual; also 恢复正常 = back to normal.
